description: This file defines the Transaction controller class for handling email notifications related to customer transactions within the OpenCart admin module. It loads necessary models and languages, constructs an email message with transaction details, and schedules an email task.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Controller class for sending transaction-related email notifications to customers.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Primary method triggered to prepare and schedule an email notification about a customer transaction, including retrieving customer info, store info, language settings, and creating an email task.
